text:
The defendant's admission that he was indifferent to the consequences of driving recklessly supports a finding of recklessness, not intent to cause serious bodily injury, so assault with intent to cause serious bodily injury is unsupported; attempted manslaughter also requires intent to kill, which he denied. His conduct is best characterized as a reckless offense such as reckless endangerment (or depraved-heart murder if the risk was extreme), not either listed option.  
CONFIDENCE: 80
